title: Hardware Prototyping
content: Kevin's hardware experience includes STM32 and ESP32 microcontrollers, PCB design in Altium, Arduino-based firmware, 3D printing, CAD in Fusion 360 and OnShape, soldering and assembly, servo and motor control, and sensor integration. His Midnight Sun experience focused on double-layer PCB routing, ERC/DRC-clean board work, and SMD soldering/testing. Several portfolio projects combine custom mechanical design with embedded electronics and real-time control.
